description: Get deterministic directional scores and sub-signal breakdowns for a coin. Optional 7D/30D values are volatility-scaled heuristic scenarios, not calibrated targets or probabilities.

coin.description: Ticker, canonical coin slug, or CoinGecko ID to get predictions for (for example, `BTC` or `bitcoin`). A curated coin's ticker resolves to its slug.

name: get_price_prediction

distanceFrom7dHigh.description: Price relative to the highest hourly close of the last 7 days, as a decimal fraction (-0.0426 = 4.26% below that high). Zero or negative.

distanceFrom7dLow.description: Price relative to the lowest hourly close of the last 7 days, as a decimal fraction (0.1245 = 12.45% above that low). Zero or positive.

modelConfidence.description: Legacy name: signal breadth and agreement from 0 to 100 (how many signals are live and how far they agree). Not a probability or a statistical confidence.

return24h.description: 24-hour price return as a decimal fraction (0.0215 = +2.15%), from the CoinGecko snapshot taken when the coin was scored.

return30d.description: 30-day price return as a decimal fraction (0.0564 = +5.64%), from hourly closes.

return7d.description: 7-day price return as a decimal fraction (0.0875 = +8.75%), from hourly closes.

confidence.description: Legacy name: signal breadth and agreement from 0 to 100, the coin's modelConfidence. Not a probability, and not the coverage of the low/high range (that is 80%).

expectedReturn.description: The scenario midpoint as a return from the spot price, a fraction (0.038 is +3.8%): expectedPrice is spotPrice x (1 + expectedReturn), up to rounding.

highPrice.description: High of the 80% range: the 90th percentile of the same lognormal (expectedPrice x exp(1.2816 x volatility x sqrt(days))).

lowPrice.description: Low of the 80% range: the 10th percentile of a lognormal centred on expectedPrice at the coin's 30-day realized daily volatility (expectedPrice x exp(-1.2816 x volatility x sqrt(days))). Assumes lognormal moves; fat tails leave the range more often than one time in five.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Price prediction
